# p0_aws_federation (Resource)

An AWS federation app: one app in an identity provider that signs users in to AWS accounts.

AWS accounts use the app by setting 'login.federation' on their 'p0_aws_iam_write' resource. P0 needs the identity
provider's directory integration (for example 'p0_okta_directory_listing') to assign AWS roles to users in the app.

**Preview**: This resource may change.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One Okta AWS federation app. Install the Okta directory integration first: P0 uses it
# to assign AWS roles to users in the app.
resource "p0_aws_federation" "example" {
  id = "okta-prod"
  okta = {
    app_id = "0oa1234567890abcdef"
    # Use "alias-and-role-name" when the app signs in to several AWS accounts.
    role_label_format = "role-name"
  }
}

# An AWS account that users log in to with the federation app.
resource "p0_aws_iam_write" "example" {
  id = p0_aws_iam_write_staged.example.id
  login = {
    type       = "federated"
    federation = p0_aws_federation.example.id
    # Name of the IAM SAML identity provider in this account that trusts the app.
    saml_provider = "okta-saml"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) A unique identifier for this federation app (lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens)
- `okta` (Attributes) The federation app in Okta (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--okta))

### Read-Only

- `state` (String) This item's install progress in the P0 application:
	- 'stage': The item has been staged for installation
	- 'configure': The item is available to be added to P0, and may be configured
	- 'installed': The item is fully installed

<a id="nestedatt--okta"></a>
### Nested Schema for `okta`

Required:

- `app_id` (String) Okta AWS federation app ID

Optional:

- `role_label_format` (String) How the federation app names an AWS role:
    - 'role-name': The app signs in to one AWS account (default)
    - 'alias-and-role-name': The app signs in to several AWS accounts, and names roles "[alias] -- role"
